page_title: WHU 3-1 LUT | West Ham v Luton 11/05/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' The referee blows his whistle for the final time to end this match.
90+5' The resulting corner from Luke Berry (Luton) only finds one of the defenders, who heads it out of danger.
90+3' Substitution. Angelo Ogbonna leaves the pitch and is replaced by Kaelan Casey (West Ham).
90' 6 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
90' The resulting set piece from Luton is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
87' Here comes a substitution. Lucas Paqueta is given a rest as he is replaced by Danny Ings (West Ham).
87' Rob Edwards prepares a substitution. Alfie Doughty is replaced by Luke Berry (Luton).
86' West Ham can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
84' Here's the change. Emerson leaves the pitch and Aaron Cresswell (West Ham) comes on as a substitute.
84' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Cauley Woodrow (Luton) comes onto the pitch for Reece Burke.
83' Carlton Morris (Luton) receives a yellow card from the referee for a foul that he committed a little earlier.
82' Luton have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
80' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Luton.
79' Reece Burke (Luton) violates the rules and gets a yellow card.
77' Vladimir Coufal (West Ham) is having a lively performance. He is causing problems and wanting the ball at every opportunity.

76' 3 - 1 Mohammed Kudus produces a sweet pass and picks out George Earthy (West Ham) inside the box. He quickly takes a shot which goes into the bottom right corner and leaves the goalkeeper helpless. He makes it 3:1!
75' David Moyes has decided to substitute Michail Antonio and he is replaced by George Earthy (West Ham).
73' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Chiedozie Ogbene (Luton) replaces Fred Onyedinma.
72' The ball goes out for a corner. West Ham can continue in their attacking effort.
70' Luton are playing some nice combination football, sending it precisely from player to player, but a defender shows good anticipation and ends the move with a good block.

65' 2 - 1 The ball rebounds and arrives at the feet of Tomas Soucek (West Ham) just outside the box. He doesn't think twice and fires a brilliant shot into the bottom left corner. His attempt was beyond the reach of Thomas Kaminski. 2:1.
65' West Ham take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
64' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from West Ham comes to nothing. West Ham will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
63' The ball rebounds to Fred Onyedinma (Luton) inside the box after a goalmouth scramble, but he whips the ball high over bar. The ball goes out of play and West Ham will have a goal kick.
63' West Ham failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat. Corner kick. West Ham will have an opportunity.

61' A rebound falls to Jarrod Bowen (West Ham) in space inside the box. He looks up and fires in a powerful shot at goal that flies just wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Luton.
61' Michail Antonio (West Ham) is well placed to meet a cross and sends a difficult header directed into the roof of the net, but the goalkeeper reacts well to stop his effort.

59' Jarrod Bowen (West Ham) reacts superbly inside the box to get first to the rebound. From about the penalty spot he produces a header towards the middle of the net, but Thomas Kaminski pulls off a magnificent save to keep the ball out of the net.
57' Elijah Adebayo (Luton) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.

54' 1 - 1 Goal! James Ward-Prowse (West Ham) picks up the ball from a rebound and from the edge of the box he unleashes a low shot into the bottom left corner. Thomas Kaminski is unable to keep the ball out of the net. It's 1:1.
54' Jarrod Bowen (West Ham) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence.
52' Emerson (West Ham) has to be very careful for the rest of the match after receiving a yellow card from the referee for a bad tackle on an opponent.
52' James Ward-Prowse (West Ham) steps up to take the corner. He launches the ball into the penalty area, but it only finds the head of an opposing player who clears the danger.
51' Jarrod Bowen (West Ham) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him. The linesman makes the right call and West Ham will have a corner.
51' Teden Mengi (Luton) is penalised for holding. Michael Oliver signals a set piece.
46' Mohammed Kudus (West Ham) makes a rough challenge and the referee blows for a foul.
46' The second half gets underway.
45+5' Michael Oliver has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.

45+3' Michail Antonio (West Ham) fancies his chances and unleashes a powerful shot from the edge of the box, but the keeper just watches it go high over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Luton.
45+2' James Ward-Prowse (West Ham) quickly takes the corner kick with a short pass.
45' The fourth official shows 5 min. of added time.
43' Lucas Paqueta (West Ham) picks out Michail Antonio with a fine lofted pass, but the latter wasn't able to create some space to get into shooting range.
39' Ross Barkley (Luton) is substituted due to injury. Rob Edwards gives a chance to Jordan Clark.
38' Ross Barkley (Luton) is asking for medical treatment, but he will have to leave the pitch in order to receive help from the physio.
36' Kurt Zouma (West Ham) makes a rough challenge and Michael Oliver blows his whistle for a foul.
34' Vladimir Coufal (West Ham) sends the ball into the box from the side of the pitch, but his cross is blocked.
31' Mohammed Kudus (West Ham) tries a pot shot from the edge of the box, but it goes narrowly wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Luton will have a goal kick.

26' Mohammed Kudus (West Ham) is all over the pitch today. He is full of energy and asking for the ball, while his ability to control the game and to be on the ball is simply fantastic. Every manager wants to have a playmaker like him.
24' Jarrod Bowen (West Ham) expertly controls the pass inside the penalty area and shoots, but it's inadvertently blocked a defender.
23' Jarrod Bowen (West Ham) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
21' Alfie Doughty (Luton) takes the corner kick, but Alphonse Areola reads it well and stops the effort.
20' Tahith Chong (Luton) is unable to feed an accurate cross into the box.
19' Mohammed Kudus (West Ham) collects a pass on the edge of the box and unleashes a shot which is brilliantly blocked by a defender.
18' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Jarrod Bowen (West Ham).
18' The ball is cleared after Michail Antonio (West Ham) attempted to dribble past an opposing player. The ball has crossed the sideline. West Ham are taking a throw-in.
16' Alfie Doughty (Luton) takes the corner but only sends it into a huddle of the defenders and one of them makes a good clearance.

13' Jarrod Bowen (West Ham) attempts to test the goalkeeper after collecting a cross inside the penalty area. Luck doesn't appear to be on his side today as his attempt rattles the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Luton.
11' The free kick from the edge of the box is taken by James Ward-Prowse (West Ham), but he hits it straight in the defensive wall.
10' Ross Barkley (Luton) is cautioned by the referee for a foul that he committed a little earlier.
10' Vladimir Coufal (West Ham) produces a dangerous lofted cross into the box which is intercepted.

9' The defence just can't clear the ball and a rebound eventually falls to Mohammed Kudus (West Ham) deep inside the box, but his well-hit shot flies just wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Luton will have a goal kick.

6' 0 - 1 A perfect lofted pass from Alfie Doughty finds Albert Sambi Lokonga (Luton), who jumps highest and steers a close-range header straight into the bottom left corner. His effort was both strong and precise, and Alphonse Areola had no chance of stopping that. 0:1.

6' Jarrod Bowen almost found himself in a promising position after Mohammed Kudus (West Ham) tried to send a defence-splitting pass, but one of the defenders reacts well and makes a timely interception.
5' Alfie Doughty (Luton) delivers a promising cross into the box, but it's cleared.
4' Some great controlled play and passing from Luton. They are increasing their possession of the ball and trying to open up the opposition's defence to hit them swiftly on the break.
3' Mohammed Kudus (West Ham) shows his brilliant passing ability after picking out Emerson with a fine lofted pass.

The players are on the pitch and Luton will have the kick-off.
The players are out at last! West Ham will take the kick-off.
Michael Oliver is introduced as the referee for today's match.
